faq.question: Is shoes allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Shoes is allowed in carry-on luggage. Shoes, sneakers, and sandals are fully allowed in carry-on and checked baggage.

faq.question: Can you pack shoes in checked baggage?

faq.question: How many pairs of shoes can you take on a plane?
faq.answer: There is no limit on how many pairs of shoes you can bring, as long as your bags fit within your airline size and weight limits. You can pack shoes in carry-on, personal bags, or checked luggage.

faq.question: Can I put shoes in my personal item bag or carry-on?
faq.answer: Yes! Shoes are completely permitted in carry-on bags and personal item backpacks.
